name: @mandusec/net-proxy
description: Mandu egress data-usage gate: a COOPERATIVE forward HTTP(S) proxy (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY). The network exfiltration kill-switch — a request carrying an untrusted $MDU:* symbol is gated by the arbiter's data-usage policy (sending a symbol to an untrusted destination, or using a symbol AS the destination, requires approval → fail-closed block). Symbol-free requests pass through unchanged; model-API hosts are excluded (owned by anthropic-proxy). Pure userspace TypeScript; reuses the arbiter over IPC. Fail-closed.
